text:
Sasha K: ok team, quick sync — we need a final pass on the changelog draft before docs deploy tomorrow. canary notes, embed streaming deprecation blurb, and the new python sdk snippet need sign-off
Maya P: pinged the SDK owners yesterday, they updated the Python snippet to use the new streaming args. i put it in the PR at the bottom of the changelog draft
Devon R: link? i'll sanity-check the example for typos and make sure code fences render
Maya P: https://git.internal.redwood/docsite/pulls/412 (see file: docs/changelog/v2.1.md)
Eli G: saw a small bug — the embed streaming section still references `embeddings.stream=true` which we removed. should be `embeddings.streaming: enabled` in front matter. i can patch
Sasha K: good catch eli. maya, can you update the snippet's config block too? want same style as the SDK README
Maya P: yep. i'll replace the inline flag and run local preview. will also shorten the example to 3 lines for readability
Ira L: noted a known-issue we should call out: canary users may see slightly higher latency for long-context models after autoscaler changes. recommend adding a one-line note under known issues
Sasha K: text for that note? concise please, we only have one bullet slot
Ira L: "Canary routing may increase 95th-pct latency for sequences > 8k while autoscaler warms up. We’re rolling fixes; expect improvement within 24–48h."
Devon R: thumbs up. i'll add an inline link to the rollout issue: https://issues.internal/RED-2143
QA Team: quick heads-up — embedding examples caused a formatting regression in the mobile TOC during the last preview build
Sasha K: ugh. is that on the docs site repo or the docsite theme?
QA Team: seems like theme CSS overrides. scoped to the changelog page because of an extra pre > code rule. i can attach a screenshot in the PR comment
Maya P: if it's CSS we can work around by inlining a small class on the code block: `<div class="doc-code-inline">` — will test locally
Eli G: editing suggestion: wrap the Python snippet with a language tag and shorten variable names, e.g.```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
with client.stream_embeddings(model="kestrel-2") as s:
    s.send("hello world")
```
Sasha K: that looks much cleaner. make sure to include the note about auth env var `REDWOOD_API_KEY`
Maya P: added both auth note and the CSS workaround in the PR. also added `:warning:` emoji next to the embed streaming deprecation line to draw attention
Devon R: i pushed a tiny lint fix to the changelog markdown (missing space after list marker). local preview looks good except spacing around the canary note
Sasha K: final checklist: (1) merge SDK snippet update (maya) (2) add canary latency bullet (devon/ira) (3) QA attach screenshot + confirm CSS patch (qa) (4) tag release-manager for deploy window (eli). anything else?
QA Team: i'll verify mobile after the CSS patch and confirm in thread
Maya P: merging in 2 mins after CI passes. left a comment explaining the inline workaround so ops/theme can remove it later
Eli G: tagging @release-manager for 09:30 UTC deploy window
Sasha K: perfect. i'll do a quick sweep after merge and then we can close the task. thanks all :thumbsup:
docs-bot: CI passed for PR #412 — preview URL: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood/412
Maya P: preview looks OK on desktop and mobile after patch. screenshots posted in PR
QA Team: verified mobile TOC fix. no regressions spotted in Canary or Desktop on Chrome/FF/Safari
Sasha K: excellent. i'm going to merge and queue the release. leaving the known-issues bullet as Ira wrote it
Devon R: merged. changelog is live in the preview and looks good.
Sasha K: closing loop — release scheduled 09:30 UTC, i'll post release note on #announcements once live. thanks everyone
